eval: (()=>{const a=__app;for(const p of __sensePeople){a.scene.remove(p.root);const i=a.npcs.people.indexOf(p);if(i>=0)a.npcs.people.splice(i,1);}for(const d of __localDogs){a.scene.remove(d.root);const i=a.npcs.strays.indexOf(d);if(i>=0)a.npcs.strays.splice(i,1);}a.cam.clearShot();a.storyCalm=true;window.__house=[...a.world.streamer.ready()].flatMap(t=>t.data.houses||[]).find(h=>!a.npcs.strays.some(d=>d.pos.distanceTo({x:h.entry.x,y:h.entry.y,z:h.entry.z})<3));if(!__house)throw Error('No reachable stair house');return{entry:__house.entry,flights:__house.route.length,deck:__house.deck};})()

eval: (async()=>{const a=__app,h=__house;await a.world.streamer.ensureAround(h.entry.x,h.entry.z,160);a.state='paused';let result,reply;const bodies=a.world.physics.bodies;a.world.physics.bodies=[];try{a.pup.placeAt(h.entry.x,h.entry.z,h.heading+Math.PI,a.world);a.pup.control=true;a.pup.cancelPose();for(const goal of h.route){for(let i=0;i<2500;i++){const dx=goal.x-a.pup.pos.x,dz=goal.z-a.pup.pos.z;if(Math.hypot(dx,dz)<.2&&Math.abs(a.pup.pos.y-goal.y)<.2)break;const heading=Math.atan2(dx,dz);a.pup.update(1/60,{axis:()=>({x:0,y:1}),down:()=>false,hit:()=>false,walk:true},{yaw:heading+Math.PI},a.world,0);}}result={y:a.pup.pos.y,roof:h.deck,pos:a.pup.pos.toArray()};if(Math.abs(a.pup.pos.y-h.deck)>.1)throw Error('House stairs blocked: '+JSON.stringify(result));a.game.rooftops.update(a.pup);reply=a.game.rooftops.interact(a.pup);if(!reply||!a.game.rooftops.saved[h.id]?.cache)throw Error('Rooftop basket unavailable');}finally{a.world.physics.bodies=bodies;a.state='play';}a.cam.setShot(a.pup.pos.clone().set(h.entry.x+Math.sin(h.heading)*6,h.entry.y+5,h.entry.z+Math.cos(h.heading)*6),a.pup.pos.clone().set(h.entry.x,h.entry.y+2.3,h.entry.z));return{...result,reply};})()

eval: (async()=>{const a=__app,results=[];for(const name of['Patan Durbar Square, Lalitpur','Bhaktapur Durbar Square','Boudhanath']){await a.placeAt(name);const [x,z]=a.world.starts[name];const tiles=[...a.world.streamer.ready()].filter(t=>Math.hypot((t.tx+.5)*256-x,(t.tz+.5)*256-z)<400);const houses=tiles.flatMap(t=>t.data.houses||[]);if(!houses.length)throw Error('No stair houses in '+name);results.push({place:name,houses:houses.length});}a.cam.clearShot();a.cam.snapBehind(a.pup);a.storyCalm=false;return results;})()
